svg.aria-label: Deepesh Kakkar, based in Punjab, India. I lead teams that finish at the top. I build AI that runs where the decision happens: on robots, phones, bank logins and payment rails. Global Winner, Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon. National Runner-Up, PSB Hackathon Series 2026 · Govt. of India. National Top 5 In Track, Samsung Solve for Tomorrow 2026. Now building · kavach, a trust layer for agentic payments.
